cells.gaps: The minister said in September 2026 that six provinces had no fibre, and routes in the south-east are unbuilt. Nothing says other operators buy capacity on the national fibre.
cells.note: Fibre is in service from N'Djamena to Moundou, Doba and Abéché, so stage 3. Six provinces were unconnected in September 2026, so not 4.
